situation: Synthetic fixture: an immutable publication check ran before deployed readback.
intent: Confirm the artifact that serves the application.
actions: Compare it with the immutable source receipt

outcome.summary: The deployed artifact matched the intended digest.

went_well: The readback supplied an exact digest
went_wrong: Source completion alone did not prove deployment
lesson: Verify deployed readback before reporting a publication as installed.
avoid: Inferring deployment from a merge receipt
